talk.greet.elder.1: Hello there, young one. I'm {name}, lived in {home} my whole life.
talk.greet.elder.2: Oh, someone wants to chat? I'm {name}, an old neighbor from {home}.
talk.greet.elder.3: Hello, hello. I'm {name}; I've eaten every meal of my life in {home}.
talk.greet.elder.4: Come, sit a while. I'm {name}; I know every lane in {home}.
talk.greet.elder.5: I'm {name}, a {role} from {home}. I walk a bit slower these days.
talk.greet.elder.6: Hello, young one. I'm {name} from {home}. Nice weather today, isn't it?
talk.greet.child.1: Hi! I'm {name}, and I live in {home}!
talk.greet.child.2: Hello! My name is {name}, and {home} is my home!
talk.greet.child.3: Hi there! I'm {name}. Want to play with me?
talk.greet.child.4: I'm {name}! I'm still in school, and my home is in {home}.
talk.greet.child.5: Hehe, you found me! I'm {name}, from {home}.
talk.greet.child.6: Hi! I'm {name}. Mom says I shouldn't talk to strangers for too long.
talk.greet.adult.2: Hi, I'm {name} from {home}. Nice to meet you.
talk.greet.adult.3: Hello, I'm {name}. I've lived in {home} for years.
talk.greet.adult.4: Hi there, I'm {name}. I work as a {role}, and home is {home}.
talk.greet.adult.5: Hey, I'm {name}. I grew up in {home}, but right now I'm in {at}.
talk.greet.adult.6: Hi, I'm {name}, a {role} from {home}. Come visit us sometime.
talk.going.1: I'm heading to {dest}. It's not far on foot from {at}.
talk.going.2: I've got some errands in {dest} today, and I'll look around while I'm there.
talk.going.3: Off to {dest}. I'm just passing through {at} on the way.
talk.going.4: From {at} to {dest}. I know this road by heart.
talk.going.5: Going to see a friend in {dest}. We've got plans, so I can't be late.
talk.going.6: As a {role}, I end up going to {dest} a lot.
talk.going.7: I'll be in {dest} soon, but I want to grab a drink in {at} first.
talk.going.8: Something's waiting for me in {dest}. Gotta go!
talk.rest.1: Just resting my feet here in {at}. They get sore after a long walk.
talk.rest.2: Taking a stroll in {at}. The breeze feels great.
talk.rest.3: Nothing much going on, just wandering around {at}.
talk.rest.4: Sitting here in {at} doing nothing. It's the most relaxing part of my day.
talk.rest.5: Walking around {at} and checking out any new shops.
talk.rest.6: Taking a break before moving on. There's plenty of shade here in {at}.
talk.rest.7: It's rare to have free time, so I'm taking a slow walk around {at}.
talk.rest.8: Tired from walking, so I'm finding a spot to sit in {at}.
talk.night.1: It's so late. I should head back to {home} and get some sleep.
talk.night.2: It's late and the shops in {at} are all closed. Time for me to go home too.
talk.night.3: Still out past midnight... I'll head back to {home} soon.
talk.night.4: If I don't go home now, my family will nag me.
talk.night.5: Hardly anyone on the streets at this hour. I'll hurry back to {home}.
talk.night.6: Nights are chilly. I should put on a jacket on the way home.
talk.rain.1: Ugh, raining again. Good thing I brought an umbrella.
talk.rain.2: Walking in the rain is such a hassle. My shoes are soaked.
talk.rain.3: It's really pouring. Let me take shelter here in {at} for a bit.
talk.rain.4: Even with an umbrella I get wet. Tainan rain just comes out of nowhere.
talk.rain.5: It's raining here. I wonder if it's raining in {dest} too.
talk.rain.6: The roads get slippery when it rains, so I'm walking slowly to be safe.
talk.recommend.1: If you visit {home}, you have to try our {spec}. Nowhere else compares.
talk.recommend.2: Our {spec} in {home} is famous. Give it a try if you get the chance.
talk.recommend.3: At night, go check out {market}. Lots to see and lots to eat.
talk.recommend.4: If you're after a late-night snack, {market} is my top pick.
talk.recommend.5: The {spec} of {home} is our pride. You'll see once you taste it.
talk.recommend.6: Buy {spec} by day and stroll through {market} by night. That's the perfect plan.
talk.recommend.7: {home} is where I grew up. It's worth taking your time to walk around.
talk.recommend.8: Next time you're in Tainan, make sure to take a lap around {market}.
talk.event.1: Oh, by the way, {event} is on in {at} today. Don't miss it!
talk.event.2: Did you know? {event} is happening right here in {at} today. It's packed.
talk.event.3: {at} is extra lively today because of {event}. I'm going to check it out.
talk.event.4: {event} only comes once a year. Lucky we caught it.
talk.event.5: Want to go see {event} together? It's right here in {at}.
talk.event.6: The reason the streets are so crowded today is {event}.

talk.basket.2: I picked up a basket of {carry} to take home for the family.
talk.basket.3: {carry} is in season, so I bought a whole basket.
talk.basket.4: Got this {carry} from the {home} farmers' association. Cheaper and better than the market.
